mission_04: Use np.linalg.eig(A) to compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
The eigenvalue equation is A @ v = lambda * v.
For symmetric matrices, eigenvectors are orthonormal: v_i . v_j = 0 for i != j.
Reconstruct A using V @ np.diag(eigenvalues) @ V.T.
Eigenvectors are returned as columns of the eigenvectors matrix.
